excerpt.zh:
对[from.GetName]进行细致的地理学调查发现在冷冻的地壳下流动着半凝固的氨河流。提高地热压力将驱动这些物质穿过脆弱表面的裂隙。

这些喷发口遍布行星表面，射出的危险蒸汽和氨泥浆的敏感混合物。当暴露在极端的表面低温后瞬间冻结，这些烂泥形成了遍布易采收高价值晶体的广阔平原。

texts.en:
Detailed geological surveys of [from.GetName] have revealed rivers of semi-frozen ammonia flowing beneath its frozen crust. Rising geothermal pressures drive this substance through fissures in the brittle surface.

These eruptions spew a volatile mixture of hazardous vapors and ammonia slush across the surface of the planet. Refreezing as it becomes exposed to the extreme surface temperatures, the slush forms sprawling plains of easily harvestable and valuable crystals.
